verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an API path for managing locations and zones across sites (the docs page is tabbed for API), and readers must be registered to a location. Readers can be registered by registration code, serial number or order number without physical possession, and the official MCP server gives agents tools to call the Stripe API. Together these support an agent provisioning a location end-to-end. missing for 10: an explicit statement that reader registration (e.g. by serial number) works via API rather than only the Dashboard, a documented create-location endpoint example, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven provisioning flow.
